key_highlights: ASX slides as banks and miners wobble; iron ore crash pressures BHP, RIO, FMG
Geopolitical oil shock: Houthis seize choke point, Saudi pipeline shutdown, Iran 'October surprise' looms — oil spikes, AUD hit
Mortgage stress and negative equity intensify among young Australians; house prices falling
Fuel excise cut debate pressures Albanese government; petrol prices climbing
Fed meeting in focus; ASX treads water post-oil spike
Major private hospital operator to be broken up after lender-backed consortium bid
AI spending debate intensifies globally; ASX tech shrugs off Wall Street AI sell-off
Taxpayer-backed steelworks to shed hundreds of jobs; structural industrial decline

sectors.trend: Iron ore crash confirmed; miners wobble on ASX. Small-cap exploration active: Critica (19Mt tin-tungsten, Tassie), Forrestania (2Mt WA gold), Sarytogan (97.7% battery-grade graphite), PLC Resources (WA gold). Steelworks job losses signal structural demand weakness.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore decline. Gold and critical-minerals names offer relative strength. Steel sector (BLT.AX) under structural threat.

sectors.trend: Banks wobble on ASX. Mortgage stress and negative equity among young borrowers raise NPL concerns. Housing price declines pressure loan books. Insurer testing self-driving car discounts signals product innovation.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX face elevated credit-risk narrative. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by falling property values. Monitor RBA response to housing stress.

sectors.trend: Oil spikes on Houthi choke-point seizure, Saudi pipeline shutdown, and Iran threat. Fuel prices climbing domestically. Australia nears energy inflection point. Airlines pressured by oil spike.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. QAN.AX, DLP.AX face margin compression. Domestic energy transition (renewables, gas) gains policy momentum.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator to be broken up via lender-backed consortium bid. Sector consolidation underway.
sectors.implications: Private hospital operators (IAG.AX, HCN.AX, SSW.AX) face M&A/consolidation dynamics. CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. Monitor deal structure for sector-wide implications.

sectors.trend: ASX tech shrugs off Wall Street AI sell-off. Global debate on AI capex ROI (Alibaba, Amazon, Snowflake, Adobe). AI agents entering payments via Visa/Mastercard. Trump vs tech chiefs on AI speed.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech (WES.AX, XRO.AX, SOL.AX) relatively insulated. Global AI capex scrutiny may hit sentiment. Payments disruption (AI agents) a medium-term watch item.

sectors.trend: Fuel price blowout pressures household budgets. Coffeehouse and steakhouse chains filing for closure. Gen Z alcohol decline narrative. Young homeowners welcome falling prices but face negative equity.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Consumer discretionary under stress. Defensive staples (WOW.AX) preferred over discretionary.

key_themes: Geopolitical oil shock (Houthi/Saudi/Iran) driving commodity volatility
Iron ore structural decline pressuring ASX miners
Housing/mortgage stress as macro risk to banks and REITs
AI capex ROI debate reshaping global tech sentiment
Immigration policy debate affecting productivity narrative
Fuel price pressure on household budgets and political risk

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical oil supply disruption (Houthi choke point, Saudi pipeline, Iran)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor WDS.AX, WLE.AX for upside; reduce airline/transport exposure
Reduce BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and critical minerals
Monitor bank NPL trends; underweight REITs; watch RBA policy response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel price spike and political instability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour energy producers; avoid consumer discretionary; monitor excise policy

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI capex ROI uncertainty and global tech correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure-play AI; favour ASX tech with earnings visibility
Avoid cyclical industrials; favour defensive consumer staples

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian energy producers on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Houthi/Saudi/Iran supply disruption supports oil; WDS and WLE benefit directly

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from iron ore into gold and critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore crash confirmed; gold and battery-grade graphite offer diversification and structural demand

opportunities.recommendation: Selective healthcare M&A play on hospital operator breakup
opportunities.rationale: Lender-backed consortium bid signals sector consolidation; potential value in restructured entities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and steel exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore crash and steelworks job losses signal structural demand decline

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight banks and REITs pending mortgage stress data
defensive_moves.rationale: Negative equity and falling house prices elevate NPL risk; RBA may need to ease

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and oil-linked consumer risk
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD hit by Hormuz geopolitics; fuel spike pressures household spending

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure (1–3 months). Oil spike supports energy but iron ore crash and bank wobble dominate. Fed meeting and geopolitical escalation (Iran 'October surprise') add volatility. Fuel prices and mortgage stress weigh on consumer sentiment. Expect choppy, risk-off tape.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and RBA eases to support housing. Energy transition and critical minerals offer structural growth. AI capex ROI resolution will determine tech trajectory. Immigration policy debate may shift productivity narrative. Healthcare consolidation creates M&A opportunities.
